description: Clock divider that counts in gray code, so that only one output changes at each clock, with eight bit outputs and a weighted sum of them

params.text: Switches between the standard gray code, where the low bits change far more often than the high ones, and a balanced gray code, where every bit changes about as often as the others

inputs.text: The clock the counter advances on; there is no internal clock, so nothing happens until this is patched

outputs.text: All eight bits added together with binary weighting, which makes a stepped voltage out of the count
One bit of the gray code counter, high or low, with the lamp beside it following it

notes: there is no internal clock: the outputs do not change until a clock is patched to the clock input

inputs.0: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
